message.content: In one of the discussions, Sova mentioned that they are currently balancing strength training with some cardio workouts to maintain a balanced fitness routine. When asked about keeping their cardio sessions engaging, Sova expressed interest in trying different types of cardio activities. Specifically, Sova shared that they were considering incorporating interval training, which involves alternating short bursts of intense activity with periods of lower-intensity activity. This type of training can help keep the heart rate up and maintain interest in the workout. Additionally, Sova suggested joining group classes as another way to keep cardio sessions varied and exciting. This indicates that Sova plans to diversify their cardio routines by including interval training and possibly attending group fitness classes.
